preconditions.description: The input n must be an integer.
The input n must be a positive integer.
The input n must not exceed 10000.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length equal to n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.
The output string must match the first n digits of the Thue-Morse sequence.
